campaign.title: Signed adjacent-odd pairing on the high singleton shell

resource_policy.literature_policy: No external theorem is presumed. Audit a primary source only if a non-elementary incomplete exponential-sum estimate is imported.

frozen_target.question: On R/4<h<=R/2, can adjacent odd denominators q and q+2 be paired before splitting chi_4 residue classes to produce the missing signed square-root window bound, including unmatched endpoints and actual amplitude differences?
frozen_target.reference_formula: P_J=sum_(R/4<h<=R/2) sum_(q odd,hq in J) chi_4(q) A_X(h,q)e(sqrt(Xhq)), with Y=R^2 asymp sqrt(X), |J|<=R, and exact actual A_X.
quantities: availability of both products in one window
cross-h phase of the paired row

completion_criteria: The exact adjacent-odd pairing identity is derived without splitting residue moduli.
The geometry determining when both q and q+2 lie in the same product window is exact.
The phase increment and actual-amplitude difference are bounded or shown coherent, with floors, profiles, hard top, and stars retained.
Every unmatched endpoint is counted with its inherited full or starred weight.
The aggregate over h is target-sized sqrt(R), or a strict signed actual-profile obstruction is proved.
Perfect-fourth-power and window-alignment controls are explicit.
A clean statement-only derivation and independent hostile gate exist.
No lower-shell, GAR, alpha, M9-M1, M9, or exponent promotion occurs without its own proof.

tasks.target: Construct the exact signed q,q+2 pairing on the high singleton shell and prove the sqrt(R) aggregate or a strict signed obstruction.
Using only the Round-57 packet, independently derive the adjacent-odd pairing, endpoint ledger, and aggregate capacity.
Try to falsify adjacent-odd cancellation using high-shell window geometry, unmatched singleton owners, top plateau rows, and fourth-power phase coherence.

review_seams.requirement: Do not algebraically pair q and q+2 unless both products lie in the same physical window; retain unmatched rows.
Character sign reversal converts a pair into a phase/amplitude difference, whose size must be proved rather than assumed small.
Keep the aggregate over h signed; do not revert to the residuewise absolute no-go of Round 56.
The blind proof sees only the Round-57 packet and its brief.
